shown.prompt: A plant has light, water and carbon dioxide, but makes much less chlorophyll. Which direct change is most likely in the light reactions?

choices.text: More oxygen is split to replace chlorophyll's supply of electrons
Less carbon dioxide is absorbed directly by chlorophyll
More glucose is split to replace light absorption in photosystems
Less light energy is absorbed to drive electron transfer
